def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):

    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):

    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

lib='''def component(grid, color):
    """The set of cells of the (8-connected) component of the given color, normalized to its bounding box top-left."""
    cells=[(i,j) for i,row in enumerate(grid) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v==color]
    if not cells: return []
    seen=set(); stack=[cells[0]]; comp=set()
    while stack:
        c=stack.pop()
        if c in seen: continue
        seen.add(c); comp.add(c)
        for di in (-1,0,1):
            for dj in (-1,0,1):
                n=(c[0]+di,c[1]+dj)
                if n in set(cells) and n not in seen: stack.append(n)
    r0=min(i for i,_ in comp); c0=min(j for _,j in comp)
    return sorted((i-r0,j-c0) for i,j in comp)

def stamp_where_fits(grid, shape, marker, base):
    """Set cells of shape to marker at every translation where all shape cells equal base; shape cells stay in place."""
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h=max(i for i,_ in shape)+1; w=max(j for _,j in shape)+1
    for r in range(H-h+1):
        for c in range(W-w+1):
            if all(grid[r+i][c+j]==base for i,j in shape):
                for i,j in shape: out[r+i][c+j]=marker
    return out
